name: Rockville (United States)
description: Banner of the city arms: white with two blue bends wavy, between them three red crosses bottony on each of the diagonals.
history: Rockville is a city in and the county seat of Montgomery County, Maryland, and is part of the Washington metropolitan area. The flag was adopted on 13 June 1979 (according to the Wikidata statement on the flag).

features.role: crosses bottony from the Maryland arms
